    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                non_bg_positions.append((r, c, grid[r][c]))
    
    # Find color that appears exactly 4 times (forming rectangle corners)

    color_pos = defaultdict(list)
    for r, c, val in non_bg_positions:
        color_pos[val].append((r, c))
    
    # Find the color with 4 positions (triangle-colored)
    rectangle_color = None
    for val, positions in color_pos.items():
        if len(positions) == 4:
            # Check if they form a rectangle (2 distinct rows, 2 distinct cols)
            rows = set(p[0] for p in positions)
            cols = set(p[1] for p in positions)
            if len(rows) == 2 and len(cols) == 4:

    # If not found, try the color with 4 positions
